state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `a-match-inside-a-character-reports-the-wrong-position` is closed. Every `Core\Str` search member matches only on grapheme boundaries: `find_from` and `rfind_from` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs` reject a candidate whose start or end is inside a cluster, and `contains` and `split` now search through them too. The Rust test `a_search_never_matches_inside_a_grapheme` and the conformance cases `tests/conformance/core/str-index-of-finds-no-match-inside-a-grapheme.nvst` and `str-search-family-matches-whole-graphemes-only.nvst` pin it. `Core\Str`'s perf is re-measured.

All three tests of `php-oracle-retired`'s `nvs-stdlib-the-m11-decisions-hold` check now exist, and its three Stage 7 gap records are deleted.

`startsWith` and `endsWith` still compare bytes, so `startsWith("e\u{301}", "e")` is `true`. The goal prose lists the search family without them; whether they join it is open.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group 'Core\<Class>'` (the group is the full class name).

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest: 33 gaps in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

items.text: **A re-subscribe to a joined topic allocates nothing** (`data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-topic-re-subscribe-allocates.json`). `Core\Topic::subscribe` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs:621` checks membership before it allocates. Delete the gap record, and re-measure `Core\Topic`'s perf.

**The topic table has a ceiling of its own** (`data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/the-topic-table-has-no-ceiling-of-its-own.json`). One connection's subscriptions in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/topic.rs:621` are bounded, and a subscription past the bound throws. If the bound needs a new setting, that is a design call: record the tradeoff and stop before an ADR.
